description: This file defines an interface class IEventHandler with virtual methods for handling container events such as start, stop, failure, and state change within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace.

classes.name: IEventHandler
classes.description: An interface providing callbacks for container lifecycle events.

methods.name: onContainerStarted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container starts, receives JsonObject data.

methods.name: onContainerStopped
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container stops, receives JsonObject data.

methods.name: onContainerFailed
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container fails, receives JsonObject data.

methods.name: onContainerStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when a container's state changes, receives JsonObject data.
